entities.summary: Wesley Fofana is a former French rugby union player, of Malian descent, who played his entire 14-year career for ASM Clermont Auvergne in the Top 14 and the France national rugby union team. He played as a wing or centre, and won the Top 14 with Clermont in 2010 and 2017. In France he is known as Le Guépard for his pace.
